locator: I q.3 a.2 co., first proof: Ostensum est autem quod Deus est purus actus, non habens aliquid de potentialitate
interpretation: Aquinas' summary of the q.3 a.1 second proof, read as being about the prima via's first mover. 'Purus actus' is PureAct InPotency: in potency in no respect. Derived in result AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A1-FIRST-MOVER-PURE-ACT, not taken as a premise.
